verdicts.reason: A: the 'Spa Utopia' title sits right on top of the busy product photo (bottle, capsule, glass), and the tagline is cut through by dark leaf stripes so it can barely be read. The original's soft blush backing swatch behind the text is gone, and the whole thing reads like a crop with text dropped on top. B has the same core faults: the title runs into the green bottle near the left edge, and the tagline sits on the white dropper and leaves. Its larger, bolder title gives it slightly clearer hierarchy, which is the only reason it edges out A.
